rich_narrative.summary: Sachse Muslim Society was founded in 2014 to provide religious education and community services in Sachse, Texas <cite id="4">through Hifdh and Sunday school programs</cite>. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="3">$3,647,357 in total revenue</cite>. However, significant financial constraints limit its current rating. <cite id="1">Charity Navigator gives the organization an overall score of 61/100</cite>, primarily driven down by spending allocation. In FY2024, <cite id="1">the program expense ratio was 13.6%</cite>, meaning the vast majority of funds were retained or spent outside direct program execution. Additionally, the organization holds <cite id="1">63.0 months of working capital in reserves</cite>, which represents an excessive accumulation of capital relative to immediate service delivery. While fundraising efficiency remains reasonable at <cite id="1">$0.11 per $1 raised</cite>, the combination of low direct program spending and high cash retention presents a major hurdle for impact-driven donors.
